note: Wooded ridge area east of Puxico with small fishing ponds. The one camping site on the area map is a grassy clearing at the end of a short gravel lane north of the area's east-west gravel road, near Pond 4. No privy or water. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Individual Campsites'; brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas on the area map', 14 days in 30. Free/FCFS/no hookups written manual. One camping site on the 1/5/2026 map (GIS 355): a grassy clearing at the end of an ~80 m gravel lane off the area road; a 23-ft rig reaches it. The GIS point sits ~60 m NW of the clearing in woods on a dirt service track; pin move proposed. No split. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas on the area map and are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' The map (Last Updated 1/5/2026) has one 'Camping site' symbol, between the east-west area road and Pond 4. Imagery (leaf-off): a gravel lane curves ~80 m north from the gravel area road (opposite lot 552) and ends in an open grassy clearing ~30 m across with a table/fire ring; enough for a 23-ft rig. No ford or 4WD wording on the way in from CR 237.

PIN: stored 36.94625,-89.99320 = GIS camping point 355, ~60 m NW of the clearing, under trees on a dirt service track (MDC: 'Vehicle use is restricted to graveled and paved roads and established parking areas'). Suggest moving to the clearing at the end of the gravel lane, 36.9457,-89.9928.
CLUSTERS: one camping site; the seven GIS lots (550-556) carry no camping symbol, so no split.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): Pond 4 (a few acres at most, under the 5-acre pond line) lies ~250 m NE through woods; nothing in view from the clearing.
